description: This file defines the CaptureNode class used in the Twig templating engine to handle output capturing within templates, including compilation logic for converting template code into executable PHP.

classes.name: CaptureNode
classes.description: Represents a node in Twig that captures template output for later use.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the CaptureNode with its body node and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the CaptureNode into PHP code that performs output capturing based on environment settings.
